title: DWG HATCH ellipse-edge derived-type dispatch
authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 section 20.4.75, printed page 195: edge type 3 is an elliptical arc, type 1 is a line.
finding: DRW_Ellipse derives from DRW_Line, so testing the line cast first encoded the ellipse as type 1 and wrote center and major-axis vector as line endpoints. DXF HATCH and MPOLYGON writers use eType dispatch and do not share this cast ordering.
correction: Try the ellipse cast before line in DRW_Hatch::encodeDwgBoundaryData; leave the remaining branches unchanged. Shared MPOLYGON path is exercised as an in-memory synthetic boundary only.
source_provenance: ezdxf 1.4.5 authored AC1021 DXFs, converted by ODA File Converter to DWG at each listed revision. Six AC1021 source/corrected DWG to AC1027 DXF source/return pairs were separately converted by ODA. The recorded converter invocation establishes the DXF pairing; the audit hash-binds each file independently and does not authenticate converter lineage.
scope: Physical source witnesses each cover one full ellipse centered (3,4), axis (4,0), ratio .5, angles 0 to 2pi, ccw, with following LINE; source and corrected AC1021 output plus arc/linear controls were checked in LibreDWG and ezdxf. The corrected writer used both existing material and plotstyle opt-ins. This is not arbitrary HATCH, native CAD, MPOLYGON physical output, or whole-file qualification.
observations: Baseline AC1021 generated ellipse is decoded by LibreDWG and ODA as a LINE edge, losing ellipse fields; ODA produced DXF with no error file.

Corrected AC1021 output has type 3 and the stated exact geometry; ODA writes AC1027 DXF with matching geometry and clean ezdxf audit. Source and corrected arc/linear controls match their fields; both corrected DWGs are byte-identical to baseline controls.
Source AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, AC1032 each decode to type 3 with the same fields and expected model-space entity membership/endpoints.
All source/return/fixed ODA logs have zero bytes, and the checked output directories have no .err files.
focused_tests: ctest --test-dir /private/tmp/ac1021-hatch-edges/snapshot-build -R ^libdxfrw_dwg_hatch_ellipse_edge$ --output-on-failure passed 1/1. Unmodified HEAD fails this test on the first ellipse boundary.

In-memory HATCH and MPOLYGON bodies cover six revisions, mixed LINE/ARC/ELLIPSE/SPLINE fields, continuation and sentinel; native full writer/readback covers six revisions, invalid-null refusal/corrected retry, and following LINE.
Integrated libdxfrw_dwg_hatch_ellipse_edge passed 1/1 in both normal and AddressSanitizer builds.
